Critical.title: Critical Events
Critical.description: If provided, determines if critical error events are to be included in the result. A critical error is an error so great that it could escalate into something graver if not addressed. Typically, a Critical error is typically an unexpected error.

Alert.title: Alert Events
Alert.description: If provided, determines if alerts events are to be included in the result. An alert error is so grave, that action must be taken immediately.

Emergency.title: Emergency Events
Emergency.description: If provided, determines if emergencies events are to be included in the result. An emergency error signals the system is unusable, or will become unusable if action is not taken immediately.

Major.title: Major Events

NextOffset.title: Next Offset
